map.Aztec 和 QR 有什么区别？: What's the difference between Aztec and QR?
map.Aztec 以中心同心方为核心、无需静区，常用于票据交通；QR 更普及。两者都属: Aztec centers on a concentric square and needs no quiet zone, commonly used for tickets and transit; QR is more widespread. Both are 2D matrix codes.
map.能存多少字符？: How many characters can it store?
map.取决于纠错与版本，短文本足够；过长会超出容量无法生成。结果以浏览器实时计算为准，: Depends on error correction and version; short text is fine, but overly long input exceeds capacity and cannot be generated. Results are based on real-time browser computation; pure front-end local processing with no upload; generated styles and code are quick-output references only—for production use the design system, specs, and browser testing.
map.矩阵尺寸取奇数并钳制 11–25；LCG 种子 = |文本哈希| + 1，递推: Matrix size is an odd number clamped to 11–25; LCG seed = |text hash| + 1, recurrence s = (s×9301 + 49297) % 233280, filled when s ÷ 233280 > 0.5; the central 3×3 finder pattern is drawn by the parity of (dx+dy) and the outer rings by the parity of (x+y), with anchor points at the four corners; each cell is 16px, canvas = size × 16
map.生成「Aztec 风格」的装饰图案：花纹由文本哈希的伪随机序列决定，并按 Azt: Generates an Aztec-style decorative pattern: the pattern is determined by a pseudo-random sequence from the text hash, drawing a central finder bullseye and outer rings in an Aztec look. It contains no real data encoding or Reed-Solomon error correction, cannot be read by scanning devices, and is only for visual illustration and layout placeholders; for a scannable Aztec code, use a professional encoding library.
